newsitem.title: USA: Virginia baseball stadium plan on hold.
newsitem.headline: Virginia baseball stadium plan on hold.

text.p: Virginia Baseball Stadium Authority has delayed indefinitely the selection of a site for a 45,000-seat stadium after the Houston Astros decided to stay in Texas, the Washington Post reported.

Stadium authorities said last month they expected to identify two or three finalists for the stadium site at their October meeting, with the most likely locations in Fairfax, Arlington and Loudoun counties.

But the October meeting was cancelled after the Astros, a National League team that was considering a move to Virginia, reached an agreement with Houston over a new stadium. Houston has scheduled a referendum next month on a financing plan for the project.
The Virginia stadium authority reaffirmed its decision not to pay $710,670 in consultants bills it has accumulated until it wins a baseball franchise and starts building a stadium, the Post said.
